areas.inicio: Your barbershop at a glance: today's appointments, queue, sales and shortcuts.
areas.agenda: Appointment schedule per barber: create, confirm, reschedule and charge each visit.
areas.fila: Virtual queue for walk-ins: register the client, watch them move up and call them to the chair.
areas.solicitudes: Booking requests coming from your public page, ready to accept.
areas.clientes: Your clients with their haircut preferences, visits and loyalty card.
areas.servicios: Your service catalog: names, duration and the prices you decide.
areas.barberos: The profiles of the people who cut: profile, order and how they get paid (commission, chair rent or salary).
areas.equipo: The accounts to sign in to the panel: who gets in, with which role and permissions.
areas.sucursales: Your locations: open, close, reopen and pick which one you work in.
areas.caja: Cash register per shift: opening, sales, tips and closing with count.
areas.comisiones: Commissions earned per barber and period, ready to pay out.
areas.membresias: The plans you sell to your clients: unlimited cuts, bundles and more.
areas.productos: Simple inventory for waxes, shampoos and everything you sell at the counter.
areas.mi-web: Your public page with online booking, editable without design skills.
areas.mensajes: Your WhatsApp chats with clients: read, reply and decide who handles each one.
areas.whatsapp: Your WhatsApp connection, templates and campaigns; the bot that books for you.
areas.campanas: Bring back the ones who stopped coming, wish happy birthdays and flag memberships about to end.
areas.suscripcion: Your DaleControl Barber plan: what it includes and how to pay for it.
areas.configuracion: Your barbershop data: hours, address, logo and team access.
